steps.en: Put the page HTML into a DOM — the browser already has one; in Node, wrap it with jsdom
steps.zh: 把页面 HTML 放进 DOM——浏览器自带；Node 里用 jsdom 包一层

steps.en: Construct Readability on a document clone and parse
steps.zh: 在 document 克隆上构造 Readability 并解析

steps.en: Scores candidate nodes, strips boilerplate, and returns title, byline and cleaned main content as one object
steps.zh: 给候选节点打分、剥掉样板，一次性返回标题、署名和清理过的正文

value.en: The same extraction Firefox Reader View ships, running inside your own extension or Node service — no per-site rules
value.zh: Firefox 阅读模式同款抽取引擎跑在你自己的扩展或 Node 服务里——不用为每个站点写规则
